warnings.message: pip: --only-binary forbids building only packages from an index; pip still builds git, local directory and source archive dependencies
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor to find them in the requirements files

warnings.message: pip: --no-binary lets docopt be built from source while building is forbidden for everything else; pip then always builds it from source, even where a wheel exists, because it has no setting that only allows building
warnings.fix: If pypi:docopt has a wheel and needs no build, remove it from installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json

warnings.message: pip has no setting for git dependencies, so "deny" cannot be enforced
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor, which reports such dependencies in the requirements files

warnings.message: pip has no setting for URL dependencies, so "deny" cannot be enforced
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor, which reports such dependencies in the requirements files
